SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) s, MAX(calendar_date) e, COUNT(*) n
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_line_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales END) web, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) rpt_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, SUM(r.returns_net) rpt_ret, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (r.business_date, r.store_id)) dist_n
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, s.store_id, p.category, o.status, o.dispatch_ts_utc
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2026-07-05')
SELECT COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_store,
 SUM(CASE WHEN category IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_prod,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_no_order,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_not_dispatched,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<>900 AND status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) store_with_order,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
 SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zz,
 COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM base

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) excluded_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN s.store_id END) stores_with_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY ALL HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 OR NOT d.is_trading_day OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN s.store_id END) < 36
ORDER BY 3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
